description: This file defines the PasswordHasher class that implements password hashing functionality using HMACSHA512, including methods to hash passwords with a salt and dispose of resources.

classes.name: PasswordHasher
classes.description: Implements password hashing using HMACSHA512 with salt support, providing methods for hashing and resource disposal.

methods.name: Hash
methods.description: Asynchronously hashes a password combined with a salt using HMACSHA512.

methods.name: Dispose
methods.description: Disposes of the HMACSHA512 instance used for hashing.
